killedBy: tallyVersusAccuracy: the versus result table's accuracy column (issue #279) refuses a self-elimination, so a player cannot improve their accuracy by ricocheting into themselves
why: Credits a player's own shell killing themselves as a hit, so a ricochet into your own tank RAISES your accuracy. `tallyCoopKills` refuses the same event as a kill; the two must agree or a slot's accuracy numerator counts something its Kills column does not.
